name: Shadowtiger
introduce:
DMS-001 影虎
由西塞罗博士设计，多尔工业制造的轻型机兵。该机拥有高纯度岚质框架与新式复合装甲，兼具优秀的攻防性能。此外，精细调整过的传感辅助系统也使得它在中近距离作战中拥有无与伦比的突破能力。

30498.name: Abnomality Mod
30498.SpecificEffects:
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> buff or debuff carried, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>3%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>24%</color>.
If this unit carries <color=#F74848>6</color> or more total buffs and debuffs, assault weapon bullet count increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

20584.name: Shadow Strike Mod
20584.SpecificEffects: When attacking with assault weapon, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> per <color=#F74848>1</color> bullet hit, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

20586.name: Tiger Soul - Unbound
20586.SpecificEffects: Ignores unit obstruction when moving. When [Toraoh] pilots the complete [Shadowtiger], movement is not reduced when legs are destroyed, and movement type changes to hovering, allowing this unit to pass over low obstacle.
